re-estize.name: Re-Estize Kingdom
re-estize.description: Feudal human kingdom troubled by friction between nobility and the royal crown.

king-faction.name: King's Faction
king-faction.description: Loyalists supporting King Ramposa III and Prince Zanac to centralize royal power.

royal-nobles.name: High Nobles
royal-nobles.description: Powerful aristocratic coalition fighting to defend their feudal privileges.

baharuth.name: Baharuth Empire
baharuth.description: Militarized empire ruled by the Bloody Emperor Jircniv with a standing army.

roble.name: Roble Holy Kingdom
roble.description: Deeply religious nation shielded by the Great Wall from demi-human incursions.

slane-theocracy.name: Slane Theocracy
slane-theocracy.description: Ancient human bastion venerating the Six Great Gods in holy wars.

black-scripture.name: Black Scripture
black-scripture.description: Elite secret division of the Theocracy comprising legendary God-kin.

agrand-council.name: Agrand Council Alliance
agrand-council.description: Council of allied nations presided over by elder Dragon Lords.

dragon-kingdom.name: Dragon Kingdom
dragon-kingdom.description: Southern realm led by a Dragon Lord scion under threat of beastman hordes.

dwarven-kingdom.name: Dwarven Kingdom
dwarven-kingdom.description: Subterranean dwarven realm within the Azerlisia range famed for runecraft.

ainz-ooal-gown.name: Ainz Ooal Gown
ainz-ooal-gown.description: Legendary Yggdrasil guild uniting 41 Supreme Beings under Momonga.

nazarick.name: Great Tomb of Nazarick
nazarick.description: Impregnable 10-floor guild stronghold populated by faithful NPCs and monsters.

sorcerer-kingdom.name: Sorcerer Kingdom
sorcerer-kingdom.description: Sovereign nation with capital E-Rantel founded by the Sorcerer King Ainz Ooal Gown.

floor-guardians.name: Floor Guardians
floor-guardians.description: Supreme defensive commanders of the Great Tomb of Nazarick led by Albedo.

pleiades.name: Pleiades
pleiades.description: Squad of combat battle maids undertaking special martial and covert duties.

shalltear-faction.name: Shalltear Faction
shalltear-faction.description: Minions and vampire thralls under True Vampire Shalltear on floors 1-3.

albedo-faction.name: Albedo Faction
albedo-faction.description: Administrative staff and trusted subordinates of Guardian Overseer Albedo.

adventurers.name: Adventurers
adventurers.description: International guild of monster hunters accepting public defense contracts.

workers.name: Workers
workers.description: Independent mercenaries operating outside guild laws to undertake illicit jobs.

eight-fingers.name: Eight Fingers
eight-fingers.description: Underworld crime syndicate pulling the strings of the Re-Estize Kingdom.

six-arms.name: Six Arms
six-arms.description: Elite enforcer division of Eight Fingers composed of deadly underground martial artists.

blue-rose.name: Blue Rose
blue-rose.description: All-female adamantine-rank adventurer party led by Lakyus in Re-Estize.

swords-of-darkness.name: Swords of Darkness
swords-of-darkness.description: Promising silver-ranked adventurer group that escorted Momon to Carne.

darkness.name: Darkness
darkness.description: Legendary adamantine duo featuring dark warrior Momon and beautiful spellcaster Nabe.

zuranon.name: Zuranon
zuranon.description: Sinister secret death cult of necromancers seeking to shroud the world in demise.

great-tribe.name: Great Tribe
great-tribe.description: Confederation of five lizardman marshland tribes united against Nazarick.

green-claw.name: Green Claw
green-claw.description: One of the prominent lizardman clans and homeland of Zaryusu Shasha.

demi-human-alliance.name: Demi-Human Alliance
demi-human-alliance.description: Host of ferocious Abelion Hill tribes invading the Holy Kingdom.

carne-village.name: Carne Village
carne-village.description: Frontier agricultural settlement on the border of the Great Forest of Tob under the protection of Nazarick.
